type: ({ state, number, tone, label, className, }: StatusIconProps) => JSX.Element
description:
The one status glyph (Woven spec section 13): a filled disc for done, failed
and needs-you, a dashed ring for pending and skipped, an outline for stopped
and the arc while running. A check or cross draws itself only once the state
has changed, never on first render.

label.description: An accessible name. Without one the icon is decorative and hidden.

number.description: The position of an ordered item, shown by a pending icon only.

tone.description: "ai" when the assistant is the actor; it turns the running arc to the AI color.
